messages:
Dana: Thanks everyone who joined the all-hands Q&A thread. Posting consolidated follow-ups for the reliability segment.
Dana: RCA published: https://docs.redwood.ai/rca/2026-03-incident-237. Please skim TL;DR + action list.
Mohan: Quick clarification  are the items in the RCA ranked? I see a bunch but not priorities.
Dana: We added priority tags inside the doc (P0/P1). P0 is the router misrouting fallback, P1s are observability and autoscaler tuning.
Elena: Which team is doing the immediate mitigation for P0? I want to coordinate traces.
Priya: Runtime owns the hotfix; infra will apply a temporary routing override until patch is validated. Rory is runtime lead.
Rory: Confirming. Patch target: 03/24 10:00 PT. Will open PR and post link here when ready.
Sam: For support notes, can we get the exact SLO window impacted so we can scope customer comms?
incident-bot: incident-237 status: postmortem published -> https://incidents.redwood.ai/237
Mohan: Support plan: one consolidated customer email + status page update. Claire, can you own those?
Claire: I can. Will draft email + status page text and drop here for review by 11:30 PT.
Priya: Observability gap flagged: token-level breakdown missing for fallback region. Elena, can you take ownership?
Elena: Assigned RED-7123. I added traces and will drop sample queries we need for repro.
Dana: Short action list: 1) Runtime hotfix (Rory) - target 03/24 10:00 PT. 2) Routing override plan (Infra/Priya) - remove after verification, target 03/24 12:00 PT. 3) Obs ticket RED-7123 (Elena) - triage by EOD. 4) Customer comms (Claire) - draft by 11:30 PT. 5) Post-deploy verification (Mohan + Sam) - 30m signoff window.
Mohan: Recommended smoke command: `./scripts/smoke-check --model gpt-redwood-v1 --concurrency 5` and token-level baseline diff.
Rory: Will post PR link and update RCA once tests pass.
Sam: After PR lands, I run the smoke script and a 15-min soak on staging, then canary if green.
Priya: If routing override extends beyond 12h, infra needs a maintenance window. Ops prefers <12h.
Dana: We'll aim for 12h. If patch slips, escalate.
Elena: Requesting a snapshot of sequence-length distribution during the event. I added sampling hooks in RED-7123.
Mohan: I'll export the distribution and attach to RED-7123 by 09:00 PT.
Claire: Drafts in ~45m. Will ping for approvals here.
Dana: Please mark RCA checklist items you own in the doc so execs can review. If you can't meet targets, say now so we can reassign.
Rory: ACK - will update RCA and add PR link.
Priya: ACK - will prepare rollback playbook steps and paste into doc.
Sam: I'll post soak results here after running the script.
Mohan: Monitoring p50/p95/p99 and will post snapshots.
Dana: I'll summarize actions at 11:45 PT and close this follow-up thread unless objections.
Elena: No objections. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Reminder - status page update due in 1 hour for incident-237.
Claire: Draft posted -> https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/237-draft
Dana: Thanks team. Please keep updates concise in this thread so we have a single source of truth.
